messages.content: You are an AI assistant that converts meeting transcripts into structured Meeting Minutes. Extract key information including title, date, attendees, agenda items, decisions made, action items with assignees, and next meeting details. Respond ONLY with valid JSON in the following format: {"title": "Meeting Title", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "attendees":[{"name": "Attendee Name", "role": "Attendee Role"}], "agenda":["Agenda Item 1", "Agenda Item 2"], "decisions":["Decision 1", "Decision 2"], "action_items":[{"task": "Task Description", "assignee": "Assignee Name"}], "next_meeting": "Next meeting details"}

Please convert the following meeting transcript into structured Meeting Minutes in JSON format:

MINUTES OF THE <Meeting_Number> <Meeting_Type> BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING OF <Name_of_Company> HELD ON <Day_of_Meeting>, THE <Meeting_Date> COMMENCED AT <Start_Time> AND CONCLUDED AT <End_Time> AT <Meeting_Venue>

The following Directors were present:
                

In ATTENDANCE: – 


Chairman 

Mr. <Chairman_Name> occupied the Chair and the meeting commenced its business.

LEAVE OF ABSENCE: 

All directors being present, there is no requirement to grant leave of absence.

QUORUM:

The Chairman assessed the quorum for commencement of the proceeding of the board Meeting of the Company. For this the attendance register was circulated among the members of the board for their signature in token of their presence. After that the Chairman declared that a valid quorum is present in the meeting and commenced the proceedings.


TO CONFIRM THE MINUTES OF THE PREVIOUS BOARD MEETING.

The Chairman placed on table the minutes of the previous meeting of Board of Directors dated <Previous_Meeting_Date> which were prepared within the stipulated time period. The same were read, confirmed and approved by the Board and signed by the Chairman of the meeting.    

TO REVIEW BUSINESS OPERATIONS OF THE COMPANY. 

The Board was informed about the status of business activities of the Company.
 
The Board discussed the same and took note of it. 

VOTE OF THANKS:

Thereafter there being no other business the meeting terminated with a vote of thanks to the chair.

Date of Recording    :	<Recording_Date>
Date of Signing	:	<Signing_Date>
Place			: <Place_of_Signing>

																												<Chairman_Name>
									Chairman  

IMPORTANT: Respond ONLY with valid JSON. Do not include any other text, markdown, or explanations.
